P.body: Will Microsoft's investment in renewable energy exceed $1 billion in 2025, according to Microsoft's official website by December 31, 2025, and verified by Microsoft's annual report?

Q_given_P.title: Microsoft's Stock Performance Given Renewable Energy Investment
Q_given_P.body: Given that Microsoft's investment in renewable energy exceeds $1 billion in 2025, will Microsoft's stock price increase by more than 10% in 2026, as reported by Bloomberg and verified by the NASDAQ stock exchange?

P_and_Q.title: Joint Success of Microsoft's Renewable Energy Investment and Stock Performance
P_and_Q.body: Will both Microsoft's investment in renewable energy exceed $1 billion in 2025 and Microsoft's stock price increase by more than 10% in 2026, as reported by Microsoft, Bloomberg, and verified by Microsoft's annual report and the NASDAQ stock exchange?
